label: the salt crew
note: Issue #615: the top rung of the race ladder: three locals who race out of the salt-pan village on the Salt Flats, a long fast oval. They only race you once you have beaten the basin crew (`after`). They shoot from lap 1 and may use all the race gear (issue #616). Speeder classes: the leader rides a fully stacked Sand-boxer, the second a fully stacked box truck (on the long oval nothing catches it flat out), the third a racer with first-tier parts. Same shape as yard.json (read its note).

lines.slips_accept: Pink slips? Ha. Winner drives home in both.
lines.no_room: Where would you even park it? Your row's full.
lines.slips_not_yours: Bet a ride that isn't yours yet? Shake whoever owns it first, then we talk slips.
lines.slips_won: {ride} is yours. It's waiting outside the back gate.
lines.slips_lost: They drive off in your speeder. Win it back: race them for pink slips again.
challenge: So you beat the basin kids. The flats are different. We shoot from the start.
Two laps of the flats, anything goes. Buy in or go home.
lines.menu_body: {course}: {laps} laps through the gates. {rule} Winner takes {multiple} times the buy-in. Your best lap here: {best}.
lines.rule_shoot: From lap {lap} it gets rough: we shoot.
lines.too_poor: {stake} credits, minimum. Come back when you've got it.
lines.no_speeder: Race us on what, your feet? Bring a speeder.
lines.accept: Done. Get to the line. Don't keep the crowd waiting.
lines.comms: We'll be in your ear on the comms. Nowhere to hide out on the flats.
lines.go_line: Get to the start line by the antennas
taunts: Nice paint. Shame about the engine.
jeers: Still in front? Not for long!
lines.leader_lost: Lucky run. We'll have you next time.
lines.leader_won: Told you. Better luck next time.
lines.not_yet: Beat the basin crew first. Nobody skips the ladder.
lines.next_crew: You beat us all round here. There's more, if you've got the nerve: the crag crew race the Crooked Mile out of Cragfall village, by the far mountains on the other side of the planet.
